context.transcript:
Okay team, here's the timeline for our next big project.
It's a print ad campaign for Thirst Quench beverages.
They want us to create a campaign for their new line of all natural organic soft drinks.
Our proposal is due to Thirst Quench in early August.
Once they approve it, we should have plenty of time to create our first draft of the ads.
The client would like us to present our first draft at their offices, so please keep your schedules clear that day.
So, in order to help us develop the campaign, the client sent over some samples of the new beverages.
I'll pass them around for everyone to try.
context.transcript_translation:
好的团队，这是我们下一个大项目的时间表。
这是一个为 Thirst Quench 饮料的平面广告活动。
他们希望我们为一个全新系列的全天然有机软饮创建一场宣传活动。
我们的提案必须在八月初提交给 Thirst Quench。
一旦他们批准，我们应该有充足的时间来创建广告的第一稿。
客户希望我们在他们的办公室展示第一稿，所以请那天把日程安排空出来。
因此，为了帮助我们开发这个活动，客户送来了一些新饮料的样品。
我会把它们分给大家尝尝。
